ya10.3.3:1.1: Yo cakkhund. parijānissati; so domanassind. pajahissatīti?
ya10.3.3:2.1: Dve puggalā cakkhund. parijānissanti, no ca domanassind. pajahissanti; pañca puggalā cakkhundriyañ ca parijānissanti, domanassindriyañ ca pajahissanti.
ya10.3.3:3.1: Yo vā pana domanassind. pajahissati, so cakkhund. parijānissatīti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.3:4.1: Yo cakkhund. parijānissati, so anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvissatīti?
ya10.3.3:5.1: Cha puggalā cakkhund. parijānissanti, no ca anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvissanti; ye puthujjanā maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti, te cakkhundriyañ ca parijānissanti, anaññātaññassāmītindriyañ ca bhāvissanti.
ya10.3.3:6.1: Yo v. p. aññātaññassāmītind. bhāvissati, so cakkhund. parijānissatīti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.3:7.1: Yo cakkhund. parijānissati, so aññind. bhāvissatīti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.3:8.1: Yo v. p. aññind. bhāvissati, so cakkhund. parijānissatīti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.3:9.1: Yo cakkhund. parijānissati, so aññātāvind. sacchikarissatīti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.3:10.1: Y. v. p. aññātāvind. sacchikarissati, so cakkhund. parijānissatīti?
ya10.3.3:11.1: Aggamaggasamaṅgī aññātāvind. sacchikarissati, no ca cakkhund. parijānissati; satta puggalā aññātāvindriyañ ca sacchikarissanti, cakkhundriyañ ca parijānissanti.
ya10.3.3:12.1: Yo domanassind. pajahissati, so anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvissatīti?
ya10.3.3:13.1: Cattāro puggalā domanassind. pajahissanti, no ca anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvissanti. Ye puthujjanā maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti, te domanassindriyañ ca . . .
